fato_historico: 1868: American Indian Wars: Battle of Washita River: United States Army Lieutenant Colonel George Armstrong Custer leads an attack on Cheyenne living on reservation land.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos encourages you to honor the resilience of the soul. Just as history teaches us about the strength needed to protect one's path, you may find that today is a perfect time to stand firm in your truth. Consider how your unique spirit navigates challenges with grace, perhaps using this energy to advocate for peace and personal growth within your circle.
frase_do_dia: Strength is found in the courage to remain true to your beautiful heart.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of humanitarian wisdom and spiritual depth.
conselho: Trust your instincts and choose kindness when navigating difficult emotional terrain today.
